ai_content.desc_en: HIP - High Intellectual Potential is a story of Morgane's adventures, a 38-year-old woman with three children, two ex-wives, and an IQ of 160. Her destiny as a cleaner is turned upside-down when her extraordinary abilities are spotted by the police, who offer her a job as a consultant. As she delves into the world of crime and mystery, she must use her intelligence and wit to solve complex cases.
